market_summary: All 5 symbols are consolidating in late New York session hours with contracting volatility envelopes and below-average RVOL (<1.0 across the board). EURUSD, GBPUSD, and XAGUSD sit heavy near daily lows beneath their respective Value Areas and VWAPs, but lack high-volume breakout confirmation to warrant chasing shorts into major session support. US100 trades inside a positive-dampening GEX regime wedged against Call Wall #1, while BTCUSD chops in a narrow band between EMA20 and EMA50 within its session Value Area. Discretionary discipline favors full HOLD across all assets.

signals.rationale: EURUSD trades below VAL (1.10482) and below POC (1.10599). Approximate CVD is NEUTRAL (-8,115) with negative slope (-807.46). Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is firmly below downward sloping VWAP (1.10521) and EMA50 (1.10419). Candles are hugging the lower ATR band (1.10219) near Session Low (1.10217). RVOL is low at 0.934 with no yellow breakout volume. Given the severe intraday stretch into the lower ATR band and lacking RVOL volume confirmation for an extended flush, prefer HOLD.

Current market session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price remains well below descending VWAP (1.32297) and EMA50 (1.32223). Price action sits just above the lower ATR band (1.32029) and above Session Low (1.32049). Volume is muted with RVOL at 0.553. With divergent CVD slope and compressed volatility right above session support, entry offers poor asymmetry. Prefer HOLD.

US100 is inside the Value Area (VAL 27934.23, VAH 28513.99) and below POC (28269.40). Approximate CVD is NEUTRAL (-0.90) with mild positive slope (+0.25). Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is below VWAP (28137.15) and below EMA50 (28032.34), but has reclaimed EMA20 (27912.71). ATR channel is contracting mid-range. RVOL is 0.748 (consistent with index CFD characteristics). GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING (dealers dampening volatility) above Gamma Flip (27869.11). Live price (27932.41) has rallied straight into Call Wall #1 (27891.54) and VAL resistance, leaving minimal headroom for an unconfirmed upside push. Confluence dictates mean-reversion chop. Prefer HOLD.

RVOL is very low at 0.554 with no volume breakout interest. There is no active sweep or clean acceptance around key S/R levels (nearest support 68019.40, resistance 70156.40). Prefer HOLD in tight range consolidation.
